caption: The drawing depicts a single knitted beanie hat, presented in a side profile view with the open end facing to the right. The hat is composed of horizontal rows of ribbed knitting, meticulously detailed with varying gradients of gray and white, suggesting a woolen texture. The exterior of the beanie is rendered in light gray tones, with darker shading used to articulate the depth and contour of each ribbed section. The inner portion of the hat, visible at the opening, is shaded more darkly, distinguishing the inside from the outside surface. The background is a plain, light beige color, devoid of additional elements or distractions. In the lower right corner, the name "Richard Whitaker" is written in a small, neat script.
title: White Linen Corded Bonnet
